articles.title: Scaling a side project to 10k users
articles.description: What started as a weekend idea slowly turned into a product used by thousands. Here's what I learned about infrastructure, patience, and why "just ship it" only works when you're ready to handle what comes next.

articles.title: Why I still love writing vanilla JavaScript
articles.description: Even with frameworks evolving every month, I keep coming back to plain JavaScript. There's something pure about writing logic that runs instantly in the browser — no setup, no build step, just you and the code.

articles.title: The cost of over-engineering
articles.description: Sometimes we build systems so flexible that no one can understand them later — including ourselves. This post is a reminder that clarity often scales better than cleverness.
